introduce: Bend your elbows at 90 degrees. Turn your palms up, clench your fists with your thumbs pointed outward.\n\nExhale, rotate your forearms outward horizontally. Inhale as you return to the starting position. Repeat.
name: SHOULDER OUTWARD ROTATION

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Exhale when rotating your forearms outward, and inhale when bringing them back.
Please squeeze your shoulder blades when rotating outward.
Please always keep your shoulders flat.

introduce: Sit upright. Inhale, lift your arms overhead with your palms facing inward, and stretch your chest out.\n\nExhale, slowly lower your arms back down. Repeat.
name: BACK ARCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you lift your arms and exhale when you lower them.
This exercise helps stretch your upper body.

introduce: Cross your fingers with your palms together. Take your wrist circles one way.\n\nMaintain steady breathing. Reverse your direction and repeat.
name: CHAIR WRIST STRETCH

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe regularly.
Keep your palms together.
This exercise promotes wrist flexibility and helps ease wrist pain.

introduce:
Extend your left arm forward with your palm facing up.

Gently pull the fingers of your left hand back toward your body using your right hand.

Breathe naturally throughout. Repeat.
name: CHAIR FOREARM STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your forearm.

introduce:
Extend your right arm forward with your palm facing up.

Gently pull the fingers of your right hand back toward your body using your left hand.

Breathe naturally throughout. Repeat.
name: CHAIR FOREARM STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise stretches your forearm.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair. 

Tuck your chin, and round your back as you exhale. Then take a breath in, and look up, trying to drive your chest out. 

Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR CAT COW

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your feet flat on the floor.
Inhale when you drive your chest out, and exhale when you round your back.
You should not feel tenseness in your shoulders or back.
This exercise works on your upper back and helps stretch your spine.

introduce:
Extend your left arm straight across your body, parallel to the ground.

Exhale, use your right forearm to support and pull your left arm toward your chest.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing normally.
name: CHAIR SHOULDER STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder and stretch in the back of your left shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Extend your right arm straight across your body, parallel to the ground.

Exhale, use your left forearm to support and pull your right arm toward your chest.

Hold for a few seconds, breathing normally.
name: CHAIR SHOULDER STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please keep your stretched arm straight.
You should feel a little tension in your shoulder and stretch in the back of your right shoulder.
This exercise stretches your shoulders.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Place your left hand behind your back and slide it down as far as possible. Use your right hand to hold your left elbow.\n\nExhale, gently lean your upper body to the right. Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: CHAIR TRICEPS SIDE BEND LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Take deeper stretches with every breath.
You can feel your triceps, obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce: Place your right hand behind your back and slide it down as far as possible. Use your left hand to hold your right elbow.\n\nExhale, gently lean your upper body to the left. Hold for a few seconds, breathing deeply and steadily.
name: CHAIR TRICEPS SIDE BEND RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Take deeper stretches with every breath.
You can feel your triceps, obliques and lower back stretched.

introduce:
Sit upright. Place your hands behind your ears, with your elbows pointing outward.

Exhale, slowly rotate your upper body to the right as far as possible.

Inhale, switch sides and repeat. Breathe regularly throughout.
name: CHAIR TORSO TWIST

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Please rotate your body gently and slowly.
Your toes and knees should always face forward.
Make sure your abs muscles are engaged.
Breathe regularly throughout.
Please relax your shoulders.
This exercise stretches your back and hips.

introduce: Place your hands behind your ears, with your elbows pointing outward.\n\nInhale, hinge at your hips and lean your upper body forward. Exhale, return and repeat.
name: CHAIR FORWARD BEND

tips.text: Please prepare a chair.
Keep your back straight.
Put your knees hip-width apart and keep them still.
Bring your upper body as close to your thighs as possible.
Inhale as you lean forward, and exhale as you come back.
You can feel the stretch in your glutes and back.
